baslik: A Switch in the Wrong Mode and a Jet Hit a Seawall

kaynaklar.wikimedia: Wreckage of Delta Air Lines Flight 723.jpg

sahneler.metin: In low cloud and fog, a DC-9 struck a seawall at Boston Logan.
It crashed and burned, killing all eighty nine people aboard.
The jet reached the outer marker too fast and too high.
Its flight director was likely switched into go-around mode.
The crew focused on its confusing guidance.
No one called out the altitude.
The jet passed decision height and kept descending.
Stabilized approach and altitude call-out practices were reinforced.

aciklama:
Delta 723 struck a seawall at Boston Logan. The cause: unstabilized approach in fog while the crew was preoccupied with misleading guidance.
